entities.summary: Front Row is a discontinued media center application by Apple for Macintosh computers and Apple TV for navigating and viewing video, photos, podcasts and music from a computer, optical disc or the Internet through a 10-foot user interface. The software relies on iTunes and iPhoto and is controlled by an Apple Remote or the keyboard function keys. The first version was released in October 2005 for Mac OS X 10.4, with two major revisions since. Front Row was removed and discontinued in Mac OS X 10.7.
